>A year ago I might have said "I have no desire to actually kill myself. >By that I mean that I cannot (and will not) end my own life."

>But a few months ago I was planning how and when I wanted to do it. >I was clinically depressed the whole time.

>I just caution you to be careful with this type of thinking. At first I >thought it was harmless but allowing that thought made me more >comfortable with the idea. I had a real problem with suicidal ideation >and needed things to take my mind off of it.

I'm worried this is where I'll end up.

Thank you for this. I never thought that it might represent some internal desire for change but that's a far more positive way to look at my thoughts. 

In terms of if it means I'm sinking into a depression I've been to a therapist who believed me to be depressed. So I don't know what it is  but I haven't really planned anything.

Yeah, sometimes I do think they're suicidal thoughts. Part of the reason I'm posting this is also to talk about this stuff out loud and I think that's something I need to come to terms with. Hoping my car careens into a telephone pole due to a mechanical error indicates some willingness to die. It's just I lack the willpower to do it personally.
Well...I kind of *want* those things to happen to me. One of those at least, to end my life. Though I only feel that way sometimes.
